secrets.name: CREDS_KEY
secrets.description: Key for encrypting stored credentials (64 hex chars; non-hex values are hashed to hex by .base44/api-entrypoint.sh)

secrets.name: CREDS_IV
secrets.description: IV for encrypting stored credentials (32 hex chars; non-hex values are hashed to hex by .base44/api-entrypoint.sh)

secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenAI API key (platform.openai.com/api-keys); defaults to user_provided

secrets.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
secrets.description: Anthropic API key (console.anthropic.com); defaults to user_provided

secrets.name: GOOGLE_KEY
secrets.description: Google Gemini API key (aistudio.google.com/apikey); defaults to user_provided
